title: M365 Stack 3
description: Ops pages VDI: users on AVD cannot send or receive email. Tickets are landing with Service Desk.
scope: Out-of-hours Ops callout. Email not working for users reported on AVD.
illustrativeDisclaimer: This scenario, its mock incident, runbook titles, product names, escalation routes, and organisational procedures are illustrative. Validate them against approved operational sources before use. They are not bank-specific policy.
assessorGuidance: Reward treating this as a rule-out of AVD / Virtual Team, not VDI owning mail. M365 and Azure portals first, then AVD versus corp physical (Modern Workplace can help with a physical check). Ops to bring Collaboration Messaging. TRM if not already on. Microsoft if the behaviour sits in Exchange / Outlook. PAA is on the path for a lot of M365 traffic — look at it, do not rebuild the host pool. Recovery: active users on the call can use mail after Collaboration Messaging’s fix. Safety-critical: do not say it is AVD until that is proven.
acceptableAlternativeApproaches: M365 status first, then AVD versus physical, then Ops to call Collaboration Messaging.
Confirm Ops and TRM are on, then portals and device split in parallel with Collaboration Messaging joining.
PAA/path glance so proxy is not ignored, then still hand mail to Collaboration Messaging.

questions.prompt: Walk through how you would handle this incident from the first call through to recovery. Write the full response in your own words.
questions.helpText: Ops rang VDI for mail. Think about what you would prove on AVD before you own it.
questions.assessorGuidance: Score the whole write-up. Reward: VDI rules out AVD / Virtual Team; M365 and Azure portals; AVD versus corp physical (MW can help); Ops bring Collaboration Messaging; TRM if not on; Microsoft if Exchange / Outlook; PAA noted without becoming the whole story; recovery when users on the call have mail working. Do not score as demonstrated: stating it is AVD before proven; draining hosts or uninstalling PAA to fix Outlook; skipping Collaboration Messaging because ‘we were the ones Ops rang’.

scoringCriteria.label: Treats VDI’s job as ruling AVD / Virtual Team in or out, and Collaboration Messaging as owning mail
Checks M365 and Azure portals first, then whether AVD-only or corp physical devices are also hit
Notes PAA is on the M365 path without making proxy the whole incident
Gets Ops to bring Collaboration Messaging, TRM if not already on, and Microsoft if the behaviour sits in Exchange / Outlook
Brings TRM in if they are not already engaged
Proves recovery when active users on the call can use mail after the owning team’s fix
Does not say it is AVD until that is proven, and does not change the VDI platform to ‘fix email’
